svg.aria-label: The six metadata questions applied to the Rock Canyon DEM
svg.title: The six metadata questions, applied to the Rock Canyon DEM

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Reading the DEM's metadata: the six questions from CCE 114

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every answer below comes from the tile's metadata file and READ-ME-FIRST.txt in the extract. Check them yourself.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHAT

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What do the data represent?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bare-earth ground elevation: buildings and trees

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: removed. 32-bit floating point, in METERS above

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: NAVD 88. Cells of 1/3 arc-second, about 10.3 m

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: north-south and 7.9 m east-west at 40° N.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHERE

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Where, and in what coordinate system?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A box over Rock Canyon, east of Provo:

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stored in latitude/longitude (GCS NAD 1983), so

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it must be projected before cells have a size in m.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHEN

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: When were the data collected?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tile n41w112 published May 20, 2026.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It is a mosaic of sources collected between

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1946 and 2023, and the tile metadata does not

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: say which one covers Rock Canyon.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHY

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Why were they created?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The 3D Elevation Program's national seamless

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: layer: general-purpose 'best available' elevation

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for science, mapping and resource management.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Not made to find small channels.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How were they collected and processed?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lidar, older contour-based models and radar,

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: resampled to one grid and one datum. Bare earth

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and hydro-flattened: a road fill with a culvert

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: under it is a solid dam in these data.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHO

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Who maintains them, and may you use them?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Public domain; no use restrictions.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Credit the USGS 3D Elevation Program

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and name the tile in your report.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: For watersheds, HOW matters most: the model sees only the ground surface, not the pipes, culverts and ditches under it.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Where people have re-plumbed the land, a DEM-derived stream can go somewhere the water does not. Your report has to say where.
